question: Estimate the realised CF DAF admin fee rate for the 48 top-100 community foundations with no public fee schedule (incl. SVCF, California Community Foundation, Cleveland, Boston, CFNJ, Denver, San Diego, Memphis, Tulsa, Tampa, Communities Foundation of Texas): divide administrative/support fee revenue from component funds in the FY2023-25 audited statements (or Schedule D / Schedule O narratives where audits are not public) by average fund assets, and test the method on the 34 CFs with published schedules (realised vs list rate at their DAF size distribution)
conclusion_affected: CF vs national fee gap (CF median 100 bps at $1m vs 45-50 bps nationals); coverage is only 43% of top-100 CF DAF assets and SVCF (17% of it) is missing
proposed_by: batch40 N11 agent (CF consolidation and fee census)
rationale: List schedules show the CF admin layer at about 2x the nationals at $100k-$1m and about 3-4x at $10m, but large CFs that negotiate or do not publish are under-represented. A realised-rate check would show whether list prices overstate what CF donors pay and would fill the largest gap (SVCF) from filed or audited data

question: Run the Schedule N / Part I line 2 screen over every 2021-2026 Form 990 filer with a community-foundation name or a CF-like NTEE code (T31) in the IRS e-file index, not only the 809 DAFRC CFs, streaming each return to </IRS990> and pulling Schedule N when Part I line 2 or the final-return box is set; record transferor, transferee CF, date, FMV and whether DAF balances are named, to count small-CF exits per year
conclusion_affected: Whether CF consolidation 2021-2026 is a handful of small exits (current evidence: 10 filed transfers, $0.5-21.6m) or a measurable trend
proposed_by: batch40 N11 agent (CF consolidation and fee census)
rationale: The DAFRC-list screen found 5 filed CF exits in 2,795 returns; small CFs below the DAFRC threshold, which are the likely exiters, were not screened. The method costs one partial download per return and is filed evidence

question: Price the all-in annual cost (admin + investment layer) of a $100k, $1m and $10m DAF at the 15 published-schedule CFs that state investment costs (e.g. Atlanta pool ~92 bps, GHCF 18-50 bps, GiveWell 5-66 bps, Dallas oversight 15-30 bps plus managers) against Fidelity/Vanguard/DAFgiving360 using the repo's in-fund cost layer (infund-expense-nationals-2026.csv)
conclusion_affected: All-in CF vs national cost comparison; whether CF investment pass-through widens or narrows the admin gap
proposed_by: batch40 N11 agent (CF consolidation and fee census)
rationale: The census compares admin fees only. Several CFs publish pool cost ranges or charge an investment oversight fee on top of manager fees; the nationals' in-fund layer is already measured in the repo, so the all-in comparison needs only the CF side
